svg.title: Хип-траст с гирей — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Kettlebell hip thrust, side view. Shoulders/upper back contact front edge of stable low bench throughout. BOTH feet flat on floor and knees bent. One clearly recognizable round kettlebell with a loop handle resting at front of pelvis, both hands steadying handle, no other weight. START hips lowered, FINISH hips raised level with shoulders and knees, kettlebell visibly travels with hips. Same feet and bench positions. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
